assumptions: Uses archived secondary transcriptions linked to original filings; all original tables have not been independently verified.
Published national percentage ratios are treated as comparable conditional voting intentions. Undecided and turnout differences remain a forecast assumption.
Seat-derived percentages and secondary subgroup reconstructions are excluded from the vote likelihood; their seat reports remain archived separately.
Daily correlated log-ratio states and sum-zero pollster effects are fitted jointly. Sampling design effect, reporting floor and variance-grid priors are explicit assumptions.
No fundamentals regression has been fitted. The initial state prior is broad, and election-wide error has only one retrospective vote-percentage calibration election.
Assumes the reported 37-list ballot and the six reviewed surplus agreements. Blue and White supporters leave the valid-vote denominator proportionally; no successor transfer is inferred.
Unmeasured minor lists share an assumed 0.7 percent valid-vote mass equally in the reference, with separate 0.2 and 2 percent scenarios.
This is a conditional pre-election forecast at the specified snapshot, not a verified official final-poll freeze or a validated claim of improved election accuracy.
